name: Journal Entry Employees Draft
query:
SELECT 
    je.name as journal_entry,
    je.posting_date,
    jea.party as employee,
    jea.account,
    jea.debit,
    jea.credit,
    jea.user_remark as remarks,
    je.company
FROM 
    `tabJournal Entry` je
INNER JOIN 
    `tabJournal Entry Account` jea ON je.name = jea.parent
WHERE 
    je.docstatus = 0
    AND jea.party_type = 'Employee'
    AND jea.party IS NOT NULL
    AND (%(company)s IS NULL OR %(company)s = '' OR je.company = %(company)s)
    AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR je.posting_date >= %(from_date)s)
    AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR je.posting_date <= %(to_date)s)
    AND (%(employee)s IS NULL OR %(employee)s = '' OR jea.party = %(employee)s)
ORDER BY 
    je.posting_date DESC, je.name, jea.idx
